INFO AND TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

Equisalud Enzimax Complex is a supplement in capsule form designed to improve the health of the digestive system. It contains a combination of digestive enzymes that help break down food and facilitate its absorption. This product is used to improve digestion, relieve the feeling of heaviness after meals and promote better absorption of nutrients. It is especially useful for people with digestive problems such as indigestion, bloating and heartburn.
